scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Let’s just have Claude Code do it. The AI handles everything—it’s super easy.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Amazing! The app was done in no time♪ Generative AI is incredible!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Right? That’s the development wrapped up!

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: However, when they actually ran the app...

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Huh? I can’t upload photos... and when I hit the post button, the app crashes.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: What... it’s full of bugs. And even looking at the code Claude Code generated, I have no clue what’s causing them...

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: {{playerName}}-senpai, how do we fix this? I looked at the code, but I honestly don’t understand it at all...

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: To be honest... I don’t really know either. The AI’s code is just too complex, and I can’t tell where the problem is...

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: So in the end, leaving everything to automation isn’t good... If you don’t understand the basics, you can’t handle it when something goes wrong.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: You’re right... Sorry, I took the easy way out. Let’s start from scratch and build it properly.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Yes! This time, I want us to fix the bugs and really understand what we’re doing together... but where should we work on it?

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: A perfect chance to be alone with her! Where should you work together?

options.text: In Nara Park, surrounded by nature
